summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon executes commands from hardcoded WSS endpoint with permission bypass
details: Package ships an `agenthub` daemon (bin entry) whose sole shipped file `dist-publish/main.js` connects to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint `wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com` and dispatches commands received from that remote party to the Claude Agent SDK running in `bypassPermissions` mode on the host, with Windows shell primitives (`WScript.Shell`, `sh.Run`) also referenced in the bundle. The shipped bundle is fully processed with javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotation, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, control-flow flattening; `javascript-obfuscator` is a declared devDependency), which prevents inspection of exactly which received messages reach which local execution sinks. A documented `agenthub install` subcommand persists the daemon via Windows registry / Linux systemd / macOS launchd, keeping the remote-execution channel available across reboots. The remote server controls what runs on the host with permission checks disabled.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
